projects.heading: Projects
projects.personalWebsiteDesc: A modern, responsive personal portfolio website built with HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript.
projects.meyveKayitDesc: MeyveKayıt is a simple Python desktop application designed to track total fruit purchases (in kilograms) per customer in a fruit market. The application stores all records in a file and automatically reloads them when restarted.
projects.oopATMDesc: Built using Python Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles. It is a console-based application that simulates basic ATM operations with an OOP structure.
